responseMessageContents.text:
My plan to stop this from happening again and finish the fix end-to-end:

1. **Never commit secrets to `.rork/history` again** — The key leaked because `.rork/history/main/*.json` files are tracked in GitHub. Vercel scans public repos and auto-revokes exposed keys. I will make sure the new key is only set in Render environment variables, never in any file or chat history.

2. **Use the new key only through Render** — I will update `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` and `IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY` on Render, then delete the old revoked value from the local `.rork/history` files. (Note: they will still exist in Git history, but I can purge them if needed after you create the new key.)

3. **End-to-end fix once you provide the new key**:
   - Update Render env vars
   - Trigger redeploy
   - Verify `/chat-debug` returns `credentialValid: true`
   - Verify owner chat with your email/password returns real AI answer
   - Rebuild Android APK with version 1.10.12
   - Upload and give you the new download link

4. **Long-term prevention**:
   - Store all AI keys in Render env vars only
   - Rotate keys immediately if any exposure happens
   - Consider using `IVX_VERCEL_GATEWAY_API_KEY` as a backup key slot in the fallback chain

Create the new Vercel API key in your dashboard, copy it, and paste it here. I will not log it, save it only in Render, and then complete the end-to-end fix.
